_about: Caught by Wireless series sounds (pick §2): same files, same gain in every part. gain_db is the series level under speech; keep it. Built by synth.py (synth + CC0 cstack-cc0).

feather-chime.use: Cora's Feather: one soft glass chime when it appears/changes

ship-horn-bed.use: sea bed with the distant horn (P2/P3 ship scenes); loop or trim
